purpose: Traceable contract for automated shaft-hub-key models

sources.implemented_scope: Derived dimensions for 6 < d1 <= 500 mm, standard lengths, r1/r2 ranges and forms A/B/AB
sources.copyright_policy: The source document and protected figures are not distributed

sources.limitation: Not complete Method B; licensed official tables and curves are required before that claim is allowed

sources.implemented_scope: Pre-solve setup, supplied research formulas and v_crit = 0.5
sources.limitation: Research proposal, not a current DIN edition; one LW is regression only, not complete Method A

sources.reference: Pedersen; Kresinsky et al.; supplied literature
sources.limitation: Never used as an acceptance criterion

requirements.statement: Reject normative DIN 6885 selection outside 6 < d1 <= 500 mm
Use one 26-band source for b, h, t1, t2, +tol(t1), d2_add and r1/r2 ranges
Do not select a standard length when no listed length fits
Keep key_nominal_length, slot_total_length and load_bearing_length distinct
Implement exact forms A, B and AB without first-character truncation
Treat forms C-J and groove forms N2/N3 as unavailable until their required geometry and licensed dimensions are implemented
Use hub_outer_over_shaft and shaft_over_hub instead of ambiguous QA
Every report result must retain an evidence badge
requirements.implemented_by: audit JSON and dynamic report generator

requirements.statement: Use v = DeltaV/V_theo and v_crit = 0.5 only under FVA-RESEARCH
Label the one-cycle NOJOB workflow as pre-solve/regression, not complete Method A
